title: NyayaSetuBenchmarkQuerySchema
description: Standardized schema for NyayaSetu legal retrieval and RAG benchmark queries.

query_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark query (e.g. DEV_Q001, VAL_Q001, TEST_Q001)

query_type.description: Taxonomy of the query structure and reasoning requirement

difficulty.description: Assessed complexity of retrieval and legal reasoning

statute.description: List of canonical statute names relevant to this query. Empty if out-of-scope.

legal_domain.description: Relevant areas of Indian law (e.g., Criminal Law, Constitutional Law)

facts.description: Structured facts extracted or specified in query. Null or empty if no fact-pattern is present.

legal_issue.description: The operative core legal question or issue framed in formal legal terms.

relevant_sections.description: Canonical section or article identifiers relevant to resolving the query.

relevant_chunk_ids.description: Known relevant chunk IDs in the corpus, if validated by judicial benchmark.

negative_or_ambiguous.description: True if the query is deliberately unanswerable, out-of-corpus, or legally ambiguous.

annotation_source.description: Provenance of the question and ground truth (e.g., 'legacy_dev_corpus', 'bar_council_exam', 'manual_annotator_1')

review_status.description: Current quality assurance and peer review validation status
